owner_request: 2026-10-11 「从这些亏损 盈利单子的特点 有没有什么可以当作二次确认的点 比如 5min级别出信号了 我先不开仓 等那个点确认了我再开」
question: On SPIKE V12.9 ETH 5m and 15m ordinary trades, does waiting for the trade to first close in profit (by m R within K bars of the original entry) and entering at the next open, with the original absolute stop and the original exit, raise mean net R after 0.2% cost over immediate entry, in the selection sample and in both check samples?
prior_evidence: exp-spike-v128-retest-entry-20260923-v1 (breakout-retest-rebreak confirmation, the V13 retest): win rate rose but all later net R negative, >=5R density fell, same-confirmation random excess negative. Winner anatomy 2026-10-11: on OKX 15m a close in profit 6 bars after entry splits trades into win 54% / +1.14R versus 11% / -0.54R, partly mechanical because it ignores the worse entry price.
rule: bars counted from the original entry bar (k = 1 is the entry bar). At each bar close k <= K: if the original stop was touched in that bar or the original trade already exited, the signal is skipped; if side * (close - original entry) >= m * original risk the signal is confirmed and entered at the next bar open. Not confirmed within K bars -> skipped. The entry must still be beyond the original stop.
exit: the original trade's recorded exit (time and price) is kept: same absolute stop, same 2R-armed trail anchored to the original entry, same opposite-signal exit. If the original exit is at or before the confirmation entry open, the signal is skipped.
risk: new risk = side * (confirmation entry - original stop); net R = (side * (exit / entry - 1) - 0.002) / (new risk / entry)
occupancy: the original serial trade list is kept; signals skipped while in position stay skipped (conservative: a skipped confirmation does not free the slot for another signal)

samples.selection: OKX ETHUSDT.P ordinary trades signalled before 2025-10-10 (exp-spike-v129-eth5m/15m-20261010-v1 run_v1)
samples.check_binance: Binance ETHUSDT ordinary baseline trades signalled before 2024-02-01 (exp-spike-manual-system-20260925-v1 ETHUSDT_5m / ETHUSDT_15m)

selection_rule: per timeframe, the candidate with the highest mean net R on the selection sample among candidates with >= 30 entries there
pass_rule: the selected candidate's mean net R is above immediate entry's and above zero in both check samples
limits: no matched random control in this version (exits are the original trades', which random entries do not have); totals fall with fewer entries, so total net R is reported next to mean net R
